title: Tower Defense POC
subtitle: Interview-ready Unity tower defense prototype with modular gameplay systems.
challenge: Built as a Unity job interview challenge to deliver a clean, playable tower defense prototype in a short development window. The focus was on creating organized systems, maintainable code, and a complete game loop within a compact timeframe.
architecture: Modular Unity architecture with Singleton game-state control, event-driven communication, and prefab/scriptable-object based systems.
